name: What is the difference between a pre-hung door and a slab door?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a pre-hung door and a slab door?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pre-hung door comes as a complete unit, including the door slab, frame, and hinges, all pre-assembled. This type of door is generally easier and quicker to install, especially in new construction or when replacing an entire door frame, as it ensures a perfect fit between the door and its frame. A slab door, on the other hand, is just the door panel itself, without a frame or hinges. Slab doors are typically used when the existing door frame is in good condition and only the door panel needs replacement. Installing a slab door requires precise measurements and careful fitting to the old frame.
acceptedAnswer.description: A pre-hung door is a complete unit with door, frame, and hinges, ideal for full frame replacements. A slab door is just the door panel, used when the existing frame is kept.
